option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf.

The option perfectly matches the detailed diagnosis provided in the leaf, including mirror-image dextrocardia, acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction, and the cause (proximal right coronary artery occlusion).
Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf, but it omits the dextrocardia and specific artery occlusion.

Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf, but it omits the dextrocardia and the specific inferior/right ventricular involvement.
